source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: When a changed localized value needs a new ID, choose an ID that describes the current action or text, such as certificate-check-test-button. Do not append only a version number to distinguish the new value.
title: Name changed Fluent IDs for their meaning, not a version number
